_comment: A spell manifest declares what cast data an add-on spell reads, so Magic NPCs knows whether a mob can supply it. Without a manifest an add-on spell is UNVERIFIED and is skipped rather than cast into the void. The spell ids below are placeholders - replace them with the real ids from the add-on you are declaring.
verified_against: traveloptics 1.2.0, cast on a real mob in a test world
_review: traveloptics:riptide_surge - direction looked right in three casts, re-check after the next add-on update
traveloptics:call_of_the_deep - summons despawn quickly for a mob caster, usable but weak
